name: @example/fixture-tiles
title: Dashboard Fixture Tiles
description: Fixture components of the wippy/dashboards browser tests: a tile that draws its own states and records its requests, a tile with container rules per size class, a component that changes data on load and one that calls a restricted API. Not for dashboards.

wippy.description: Fixture tile of the dashboards browser tests. It is not used by hand: the dashboard board creates it and sets the tile_v1 attributes. The bundle holds five tags: fx-states (draws its own states and records its requests in window.__fx), fx-states-replace (the same tile, whose claim sets computing: replace), fx-size (container rules per size class), fx-onload (changes data when it loads) and fx-api (calls an API that a regular viewer may not use).

request-id.description: A new id for each configuration. The board sets it last.

data-sources.description: Map from input name to { url, args, live }.

actions.description: Map from action name to { url, confirm, allowed }.

fields.description: Map from slot names to data field names.

params.description: Current values of the page parameters the tile declares.

state-display.description: State display preference { refreshing, computing, error }, each keep or replace.
